question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a teal ball, Bob has a silver ball, Claire has a white ball, Dave has a black ball, and Eve has a purple ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Dave and Claire swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Eve and Alice swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Finally, Bob and Dave swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) teal ball
(B) silver ball
(C) white ball
(D) black ball
(E) purple ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: teal, silver, white, black, purple.
1. Dave and Claire swap: teal, silver, black, white, purple.
2. Claire and Dave swap: teal, silver, white, black, purple.
3. Eve and Alice swap: purple, silver, white, black, teal.
4. Claire and Dave swap: purple, silver, black, white, teal.
5. Bob and Dave swap: purple, white, black, silver, teal.
Bob has the white ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
